WITH pedidos_vendedor AS (
  SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS pedidos
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
),
ingresos AS (
  SELECT seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS ingresos
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
retrasos AS (
  SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS pedidos_retrasados, AVG(r.review_score) AS calif_promedio
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > julianday(o.order_estimated_delivery_date)
  GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT seller_id
FROM pedidos_vendedor
WHERE seller_id IN (
  SELECT seller_id
  FROM ingresos
  ORDER BY ingresos DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT COUNT(*) / 4 FROM pedidos_vendedor)
)
AND seller_id IN (
  SELECT seller_id
  FROM retrasos
  WHERE pedidos_retrasados / pedidos > 0.15 OR calif_promedio < 3.5
)

  FROM pedidos_estado
  GROUP BY customer_state HAVING pedidos >= 1000
)
SELECT customer_state, max_gasto
FROM max_gasto
ORDER BY max_gasto DESC
LIMIT 1
